title: Mātugāmo
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || [page 235] XVII. 23. 7] TATIYO VAGGO 235 3 Na tassa bhikkhave mātugāmo eko ekassa cittam pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yassa lābhasakkārasiloko cittam pariyādāya tiṭṭhati || pe|| 4 Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 5 Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Pathamaṃ || ||
